description: Defines a type_index class for type identification and utility functions for obtaining type names and hashes, used for type introspection and identification within the c10::util namespace.

classes.name: type_index
classes.description: A final class that wraps a uint64_t checksum for type identification, supporting comparison and output streaming.

methods.name: get_type_index
methods.description: Returns a type_index object for a given type T, computed at compile time.

methods.name: get_fully_qualified_type_name
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of type T as a string_view.
